newsitem.title: USA: Universal Outdoor closes Indiana purchase.
newsitem.headline: Universal Outdoor closes Indiana purchase.

text.p: Universal Outdoor Inc on Monday said it completed the acquisition of the assets of Ad-Craft Inc, a privately held outdoor advertising company based in Evansville, Ind.
The assets, purchased for about $5.5 million in cash, will add about 135 display signs in the Evansville area to Universal's operations.
Universal Outdoor currently operates about 31,200 displays in 23 Midwestern, Southeastern and East Coast markets in the United States.
Shares of Universal Outdoor were unchanged at 27-1/2 in late trading on the Nasdaq.
